caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair positioned at a slight angle, allowing visibility of its front and right side. The chair has four cylindrical legs and three horizontal slats forming the backrest, all in a light brown wood tone with darker brown, more prominent grain patterns on the slats. The top ends of the backrest posts extend above the upper slat and are capped with rounded finials. The seat is constructed from woven strips, forming a basket-like pattern and rendered in a muted beige color with varying shading to indicate texture and depth. The structure of the chair includes additional horizontal stretchers connecting the legs near the base on all four sides. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color, and the artist’s name “Florence Grant Brown” is faintly inscribed below the chair, slightly to the right.
title: Ladder Back Chair
